# COMSTAR vision MCP — AO catalog (hosted on Ada / AI server).
# Co-located with CodeProject.AI — not the Pi reverse tunnel (CONTRACTS §5).
#
# URL MUST use a letter-leading hostname. Raw IPs (10.0.10.16 / 127.0.0.1)
# mint illegal OpenAI tool names like 10_0_10_16_8793_mcp_who_visited.
id: vision_comstar
description: CodeProject.AI presence/scene plus Frigate visitor history for COMSTAR
capabilities: >
  who_is_present, describe_view, check_camera against CPAI;
  list_person_visits, describe_visit, who_visited against Frigate (+ HA LLM Vision
  for unrecognized people).
  Needs a JPEG frame feed for live tools; Pi face engage stays on the bridge
  vision poller.
good_for: >
  who is here, camera, scene, objects, presence at terminal,
  who was in the driveway, visitors today
planner_hint: >
  Use for orchestrator-side "who is present" / scene questions and historical
  visitor summaries via who_visited. Do not use for session identity (that is
  the Pi face → directory resolve path).

guest_allowed: false
streamable_http:
  url: "http://nvr.mostardesigns.com:8793/mcp"
